security_controls.evidence: Conductor delegated approval requires service-created grant snapshots, service-owned persisted authority rows, safe grant ids, verified grant-file row parity, and approval-service validation before closeout loop judgment.
Fabricated grant files without matching conductor_delegation_grants rows are downgraded to untrusted and conductor-approve rejects them.
record_grant rejects raw dictionaries without a service-created one-shot snapshot and rejects mismatched idempotency replay.
Closeout ledger reuses ConductorApprovalService grant validation for conductor, packet, approval type, packet hash, risk ceiling, validity window, and evidence prerequisites.
Conductor grant events remain audit/read-model traces; closeout authority is consumed from service-owned conductor_delegation_grants rows.

residual_risk: This packet hardens service/API misuse boundaries and does not claim hostile same-process Python sandboxing.
PKT-24 validation warning is pre-existing and unrelated to PKT-26 authority lifecycle remediation.
